app.title: Strands Decider 2B: a small, open-source, decision model
app.author: gmays
app.description: Decider 2B is a lightweight open-source decision model designed for evaluating and benchmarking LLM outputs against human preferences.
proposed_tests: Clone repo and install dependencies via pip
Run the provided CLI to evaluate a sample LLM output and verify scoring format
Integrate Decider 2B with a simple Python script to compare two LLM responses and ensure the API returns a numeric score
Measure evaluation latency on a dataset of 100 prompts and confirm it stays below a target threshold
